findings.passage: “But we’ve got to pass the SAVE Act, so our voices as American citizens will not be marginalized, and prevent fraud and cheating in our elections,” she said.
findings.note: Quoted by the Boston Globe (article date; she spoke around the 2024 NH-02 candidate debates). She calls for passing the federal SAVE Act, which requires proof of citizenship, to keep non-citizens from voting and to prevent fraud.
subjects: proof of citizenship to register (SAVE Act)

findings.passage: “Why do you have to use ‘stolen’?” Williams said. “How about ‘not honest’? I feel like it’s not honest. … My questions never got answered.”
findings.note: Quoted by the Boston Globe, from a 2024 debate at New England College. Asked whether the 2020 election was stolen, she said she felt it was not honest and that her questions went unanswered. Related election-integrity talk, not about ID rules directly.

findings.passage: I support the SAVE Act — citizenship required to register, and photo ID to vote.
findings.note: The Dartmouth interview (April 2026, current campaign), her answer marked LTW. She backs the SAVE Act and names its rules: citizenship required to register and photo ID to vote.
